text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The Spring Tenno Sho Throwdown!"

"Kitasan Black vs. Satono Diamond!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Two Childhood Friends Duke It Out!"

"Who Will the Goddess of Victory Smile
Upon?!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of these spring Tenno Sho articles
feature
dramatic headlines about the
"throwdown
between the two titans."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Those two couldn't be more different, so
seeing
them face off ought to be
something special.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond was popular and highly

regarded even before her debut. They
called her
the "230-Million-Point Scion."

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Kitasan Black wasn't
very well
known at first, but reached the
top by winning
over the hearts of fans
with guts and dedication.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And they're even childhood friends,
right? It's like
they were destined to face
off here!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
But Kitasan Black might have the
advantage
today. She won last year,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Spectacled Man
text_block_list.text:
At 3,200 meters, the spring Tenno Sho
is the
longest of any G1 race. The Yodo
Slope features
large changes in
elevation, so positioning and
endurance
are key.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: What's with the sudden analysis?

text_block_list.name: Spectacled Man
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black competed here last year,
so she has
an advantage in that respect.
...Hm, I feel like
we've had a
conversation like this before.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right! When Mejiro McQueen took
on Tokai
Teio here!

text_block_list.name: Spectacled Man
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I remember now. This situation is
certainly
similar...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hah, I knew it! Even everyone else thinks
their
showdown is just like ours was back
then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Those two looked up to us, and now
they're
running in the very same race...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel a strange twist of fate is at play
here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
They watched our race in the past, so
hopefully
they can put on an even
better performance than
we did!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. At the very least, they should
be
comparable to how we were at the
time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The throwdown between two titans...
I'm
glad I can play a part in fueling the

excitement.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm contributing to the
Umamusume world
from within. It's
something the Satono family has
never
accomplished before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm thankful to everyone who's been
interviewing
me since even before my
debut.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I also have Kita to thank. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All this attention she's receiving is the
result of
how hard she's worked to bring
smiles and
excitement to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By running with her, I truly believe that
I'll find
out what it means to be an
illustrious
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But to do that, I'll need to win this race
first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita may hold the advantage of having
run in the
spring Tenno Sho last year,
but that'll just make
my win today all the
more meaningful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win this race and become an

Umamusume whose talent nobody can
question!
